name: Cadence 0.89 memory on P1, the observed cold chain: eight recipes, 10 founders
question: On the fully observed chain, where memory should not matter, does any memory recipe cost success?
scope: control reading of the memory options; development founders

episodic.note: the episodic memory votes in the choice

recall.note: the recall memory with its default position term (32 exact ages)

recall_nopos.note: the recall memory without the position term

recall_h2.note: the recall memory read by two heads

recall_w2.note: the recall memory keyed on the last two events

attention.note: the learned-code contextual recipe (recall, window 2, learned code of 8 units)

episodic_recall.note: the episodic vote and the recall memory

correct_step_qualified.note: the same caregiver with qualified teaching; a separately named numerical arm, refusals counted at the fixed budget

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window

withdrawal: the acquired life resumes from its seam with the caregiver gone and learning on; a separate frozen copy is read at the end

evaluation.note: frozen copies with their own action stream; Brain.reset at every episode start equals the life's episode boundary for an act-only reader

analysis.primary: immediate sampled success minus random and minus founder, founder-paired
